dogecoin.text: Cultural Relevance : Meme coins ride internet trends. Dogecoin = early web humor. SHIB = DeFi/NFT craze. Staying relevant keeps them alive.
Viral Marketing : Memes spread faster than ads. Remember Elon tweeting about Dogecoin? That single meme moved markets. Timing + virality = unmatched reach.

Memes aren’t just jokes—they’re crypto’s secret weapon. From Dogecoin to Shiba Inu, memes make blockchain tech approachable, fun, and viral. But are they hype or something deeper? Let’s break it down.👇
